changelog_text:
Nightly build of `master` at b19b959d625fa828c2f885e69d2a880a9fa72f80, for testing. It has not been flown as a release, so it can break things that the latest stable release does not.

Borea offers nightlies only on its `dev` channel, and SpaceDock never gets them.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/cairn5/KSAero/compare/v0.1.1-nightly.20261027...v0.1.2-nightly.20261104

## Compatibility
Validated against KSA build version **2026.10.25.5707**.

## Installation
Extract into `Documents\My Games\Kitten Space Agency\mods\`, so that the files end up in `mods\KSAero\`.
Requires [StarMap](https://github.com/StarMapLoader/StarMap).

You can also download and install it with the mod manager **Borea**: https://ksamodding.github.io/Borea/

## Downloads

| File | SHA-256 |
| --- | --- |
| KSAero-0.1.2-nightly.20261104.zip | `31fdf6064a01e9af6f3278b8e74e91f834321dd969f4cbdc3fab0bb0418c73d3` |

## Provenance
The zip was built by the nightly workflow of this repository. A promoted stable release carries the same bytes as the nightly it was promoted from, so the same attestation covers it. To check a download:

```
gh attestation verify <file> --repo cairn5/KSAero \
  --signer-workflow cairn5/KSAero/.github/workflows/nightly.yml
```

listing.name: KSAero
listing.abstract: Better Aerodynamics for Kitten Space Agency
listing.description:
A deliberately simple aerodynamics mod for Kitten Space Agency, to stand in until the game has real aero. It replaces stock's atmospheric drag with a body-of-revolution model that has angle-of-attack drag, lift with a stall, and a transonic drag rise. Rotational dynamics are left exactly as stock.

![Airflow around a cylinder](ksa-image:aeroflow)
